# Savi Saluwadana

Canonical portfolio: https://savisaluwadana.github.io/
Canonical agent-readable profile: https://savisaluwadana.github.io/llms.txt

Savi Saluwadana is a software and product engineer based in Sri Lanka with interests across software architecture, systems design, Platform Engineering, DevOps and AI-enabled systems. His portfolio focuses on end-to-end products, Go, Kubernetes, CI/CD, developer platforms, PostgreSQL, MCP and production-minded architecture.

Selected work includes Avara Real Estate, Blu.lk, FreshPick / FreshOnTime, TimelyHelp.lk, DevRelOS, Property Management OS and RapidReach.

Industries of interest include healthcare, real estate, food and commerce, logistics, shipping and maritime, financial services, industrial operations, energy, mobility, telecom and other sectors where software can materially improve real-world operations.
